messages.en:
{07 0a 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} I can't tell
you how grateful I am that
you got me that {ff 00 00 07}medicine{ff 00 00 00}.
{07 14 00}I'm back to my normal self
again, and I owe it all
to you, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
That's why I want you to
have this little token
of appreciation.
messages.et:
{07 0a 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} ma ei oska
sulle öelda, kui tänulik ma
olen, et sa tõid {ff 00 00 07}rohtu{ff 00 00 00}.
{07 14 00}Ma olen jälle endine ja
võlgnen selle kõik
sulle, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
Sellepärast tahan ma, et sa
võtaksid selle väikese
tänumärgi.

messages.en:
{07 0a 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}if it weren't
for that {ff 00 00 07}medicine {ff 00 00 00}you
brought, I'd still be sick.
{07 06 00}If it weren't for you,{01 00 00 05 00} I'd
still be curled up in bed,
feeling miserable!
{07 00 00}It's nothing special, but.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
I want you to have this.
messages.et:
{07 0a 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}kui poleks
seda {ff 00 00 07}rohtu{ff 00 00 00}, mille sa
tõid, oleksin ma ikka haige.
{07 06 00}Kui sind poleks,{01 00 00 05 00} oleksin ma
ikka voodis kerra tõmbunud
ja õnnetu!
{07 00 00}Pole midagi erilist, aga.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
Ma tahan sulle seda anda.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}You have given me the most
precious of gifts.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
The gift of good health!
{07 00 00}Seriously, without your
care, {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 16 00}I'd probably still
be sniffling in bed.
{07 00 00}So I just want to be able
to thank you properly,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Sa oled mulle andnud kõige
hinnalisema kingituse{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
Hea tervise kingituse!
{07 00 00}Tõsiselt, ilma su
hoolitsuseta, {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 16 00}nuuskaksin ma
vist ikka voodis.
{07 00 00}Nii et ma tahan sind
korralikult tänada,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
